# omadafusion_site_settings (Resource)

Site-wide settings (Site Settings and Services). Only attributes you set are managed; unset attributes keep whatever the controller has. Destroying this resource leaves the settings as they are. Use one instance per site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only the attributes set here are managed.
resource "omadafusion_site_settings" "this" {
  timezone             = "America/New_York"
  ntp_servers          = ["time.cloudflare.com", "pool.ntp.org"]
  auto_upgrade_enabled = false # upgrade in a maintenance window instead
  led_enabled          = true
  lldp_enabled         = true
  syslog_enabled       = true
  syslog_host          = "192.168.10.20"
  syslog_port          = 514
  device_ssh_enabled   = false
  upnp_enabled         = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alerts_enabled` (Boolean) Alert emails. Unset leaves it unmanaged.
- `auto_upgrade_enabled` (Boolean) Automatic firmware upgrades for devices. Unset leaves it unmanaged.
- `band_steering_enabled` (Boolean) Band steering on APs. Unset leaves it unmanaged.
- `device_account_password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the device account. Set together with the username.
- `device_account_username` (String) Username of the local account the controller sets on every device (SSH and standalone web UI).
- `device_ssh_enabled` (Boolean) SSH access to devices (Services > SSH). Unset leaves it unmanaged.
- `device_ssh_port` (Number) Device SSH port.
- `fast_roaming_enabled` (Boolean) 802.11r fast roaming. Unset leaves it unmanaged.
- `led_enabled` (Boolean) Device LEDs on by default. Unset leaves it unmanaged.
- `lldp_enabled` (Boolean) LLDP on devices. Unset leaves it unmanaged.
- `mdns_enabled` (Boolean) mDNS reflector. Unset leaves it unmanaged.
- `mesh_enabled` (Boolean) AP mesh. Unset leaves it unmanaged.
- `ntp_servers` (List of String) NTP servers pushed to devices. An empty list turns custom NTP off.
- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `syslog_enabled` (Boolean) Remote syslog. Unset leaves it unmanaged.
- `syslog_host` (String) Remote syslog server. Used with `syslog_enabled`.
- `syslog_port` (Number) Remote syslog port. Used with `syslog_enabled`.
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone, e.g. `America/New_York`.
- `upnp_enabled` (Boolean) UPnP on the gateway. Unset leaves it unmanaged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Site ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Site name or ID. Attributes start unmanaged; the next apply sets the ones in config.
terraform import omadafusion_site_settings.this Default
```
